full_judgment: 4. The learned Senior Assistant Judge, framed appropriate issues. The plaintiff examined 3 PWs and the original kabala deed dated 13-5-1964 executed by khudu Pramanik in favour of Jalal uddin was marked as exhibit-1. The mutated Khatian opened in the name of Jalal Uddin was marked as exhibit-2. Duplicate Carbon Receipt (DCR) showing separation of Jama in the name of Jalal Uddin, the predecessor plaintiff vide mutation case No. 1805 (9-1) 85-86 was marked as exhibit-3, one rent receipt showing payment of rent in respect of the suit land in the year of 1978 was marked as exhibit-4. On the other hand the defendant examined 4 DWs and the certified copies of the deed of relinquishment executed by Tasiron Bibi in favour of Karamot Ullah Pramanik was marked as exhibit-'ka'.
